tasks.task: Write a system prompt a business will run every day

items.when: When a prompt will run again and again and must be clear, structured and tied to the client's facts
When a new AI task is going into daily use and needs steps from draft to tested hand-over
When the request is rough, to ask the few questions that settle the task before you write
When you want a second draft and test cases from a different approach to compare
When the prompt is drafted, to find risky wording, likely failure cases and bias
When the prompt is long and clever and nobody has looked at real outputs yet

tasks.task: Rewrite a prompt that gives uneven results

items.when: When a prompt gives off-target answers and you want a clearer, structured version to test
When you want a tighter version aimed at reliability to set beside your own rewrite
When the prompt has no structure at all, to rebuild it on a framework that fits the task
When you have old and new versions, to see on fixed cases what got better and what got worse

tasks.task: Build a test set and score a prompt against it

items.when: When you have the client's real examples and need a test set, scores and fixes one at a time
When the prompt has run on the test inputs and you need a fair score and failures by cause
When answers cannot be checked by code, to write a scoring guide an AI grader can follow fairly
When several versions must be scored on the same cases and the best one backed by results
When the client wants one guided run from rough prompt to tested version with a change record
When "good" is vague and the test would pass almost anything

tasks.task: Write an extraction prompt and JSON schema for documents

items.when: When fields must come out of invoices, emails or forms the same way every time, with no guessing
When the client pastes a few sample documents and wants a first schema and prompt
When a developer will run it, to get code that checks each field and retries on errors
When the documents are scans or photos and the text must be read before any prompt runs
When key facts from a scan must be checked against the page, with unsure readings marked

tasks.task: Review extraction results and fix the failures

items.when: When the client pastes results and expected answers, to score them and group failures by cause
When failures are grouped, to fix the prompt one change at a time and re-score
When the output is a table, to count blanks, duplicates and odd values across all rows
After each fix, to confirm it helped and broke nothing that passed before

tasks.task: Write field definitions and map them to the client's sheet

items.when: When each field needs a name, type, allowed values and a rule for missing data
When extracted fields must map to columns in a sheet or CRM, with gaps to decide

tasks.task: Spec how extracted data flows into a sheet or CRM

items.when: When the data should move by Zapier or Make, to get a setup built to hold up
When you want a quick step-by-step sketch and what can break before you spec it fully
Before the client relies on it, to find double runs, missing approvals and recovery steps
When you must check what the client's automation tool can trigger on and write to

tasks.task: Review an assistant for prompt injection risks

items.when: When the assistant reads content a stranger could write, to see how it could be hijacked
When risks are found, to get a threat map and fixes against hidden instructions
When the owner approves testing, to plan safe attacks and report where the agent is tricked
When the assistant is a live app and also needs spend limits set
When fixes are in, to keep test cases, a gap list and retest records
When the plan assumes users and inputs will behave and nothing covers mistakes

tasks.task: Re-test prompts when a model is replaced

items.when: When a model the client uses is replaced or retired and every prompt needs a re-test
When the new model fails cases the old one passed, to fix and re-score
When prompts live in production and need versions, a registry and a safe way back
When you compare old and new model outputs on the same fixed cases

tasks.task: Set up a custom GPT, Claude Project or Gem

items.when: When the assistant needs its instructions written and tied to the client's own files
When the assistant talks to customers and needs flows, error recovery and fallbacks
Before it is shared, when it reads uploads, emails or web pages
When the client uses ChatGPT, to check what a custom GPT can and cannot do
When the client uses Claude, to check what a Project can hold and do

tasks.task: Test and tune a chatbot's answers

items.when: When the bot has no tests, to plan scores, human review and side-by-side checks
When real chats exist, to find missed questions, wrong answers and content to fix
When answers state facts, to check each claim against sources
When the review shows failures, to fix the prompt one change at a time

tasks.task: Write a prompt that answers only from the client's documents

items.when: When answers must quote the client's files and say so when the files are silent
When a developer will build it, to get code that answers from documents and shows the pages used
When sample answers are in, to check each claim really comes from a source

tasks.task: Write a prompt that sorts or tags messages

items.when: When tickets, emails or leads must be sorted into fixed labels the same way each time
Before the prompt, to write label rules, edge cases and a sampling plan for review
When the prompt has run on labelled examples, to see which labels get confused

tasks.task: Write instructions or a skill for an AI agent

items.when: When a rough request must become one clear prompt an agent can act on
When the job repeats, to package it as a skill with test prompts and a trigger line
When the agent needs a rubric in the owner's words, twenty test cases and a grader
Before release, to get a test set, scoring rules and a release decision memo
When the skill will be shared, to score it and scan it for safety and portability
When a prompt or skill should be tuned over several rounds against tests

tasks.task: Cut a prompt's running cost and watch it in use

items.when: When the bill is high, to see where the tokens go and what to cut without losing quality
When the prompt is live, to plan how to trace steps, cost and errors without logging private data
After a shorter prompt or cheaper model, to prove the scores did not drop

tasks.task: Write a set of product scene image prompts

items.when: When a shop needs lifestyle images of a real product that all look consistent and true
When the set spans scenes, sizes and tools and the product must look right in every one
Before any prompt, to write the product's true details and the lines that lock them
When the client has only phone photos, to see the product in three different looks before the prompts are fixed
When images come back, to get a pass or fail on each and one fix to add before you retry
When the real product photo must be placed into scenes by plain edit requests

tasks.task: Write brand and website image prompts in one style

items.when: When a series of site and social images must share one look
When brand, scene, product, text and avoid rules must be combined into one prompt
When one image idea should be tried as four different treatments
When each image needs its exact size and a file plan as well as a prompt
When images show people, to check for stereotypes, cloned faces and fake symbols
When you want to explore looks and then reuse the style you chose

tasks.task: Build a consistent character or mascot prompt set

items.when: When one character must look the same across poses, scenes and sizes
When the character will appear in clips and needs angle sheets and a storyboard
Before you lock the character, to try four different treatments of it
When the character drifts between images, to turn each fault into a prompt line and a check

tasks.task: Write image prompts that carry exact words

items.when: When the image must show a headline or price word for word
When one product photo should become six prompts with shared brand and layout rules
When the image must keep the real product, to get a prompt and an image check
When the tool must draw readable text inside the image

tasks.task: Write AI video shot prompts for a short clip

items.when: When a short clip is planned and each shot needs one clear prompt
When stills and clips must match and the product must stay true across shots
When you have a one-line idea and need a shot list and fixes for failed clips
When a shot feels flat, to get four versions with different camera, lens and light
When a clip shows people, to get fixes for how they look and move
When clips need sound and are made from text or a still image
When the shots are pretty but nothing tells the viewer where to look or what happens next

tasks.task: Fix hands, labels and odd colours in AI images

items.when: When feedback is in, to turn each fix into a rule with a prompt line and a check line
When the image needs an edit, to write the change with clear roles for each reference
When skin or hands look fake, to get focused fixes that keep the face and light
When a batch needs edits, to plan settings, edit requests and a log of every change
When a photo the client owns must be extended or cleaned up

tasks.task: Keep prompt versions, a change log and a hand-over note

items.when: When a tested prompt is handed over and the client must know how to run and change it
When several prompts are in use and each change needs a version, a test and a way back
When a prompt has no history, to re-score it and start a version record

always.when: Before any image or copy prompt that must look or sound like the client's live site
When a prompt or its sample output states a number or claim you cannot trace to the client

helpers.when: When the job is a full customer chatbot with flows, hand-off and a knowledge base
When the extraction must be built and run inside Zapier, Make or a similar tool
When the prompt must run in code through an API with retries, logs and tests
When the product needs real shots or a shot list before any AI scenes
When the clip needs a script, voice, edit and delivery, not only shot prompts
When the brand has no settled look to hold the image prompts to

gaps: No library item writes a JSON schema and extraction prompt for business documents with a rule against guessing; only the kit does
No library item scores extraction results field by field against expected answers
No library item sets up a custom GPT, Claude Project or Gem: instructions, knowledge files and starter prompts
No library item writes or tests a classification prompt with label definitions and a confusion check
No library item compares models on one test set for quality, cost and speed, or tracks vendor retirement dates
No library item builds a character or mascot sheet that keeps one character the same across many images
No library item checks an AI video clip for product accuracy, flicker and continuity between shots
No library item covers disclosure labels and usage rights for AI images and video by region
No library item builds a team prompt library with owners, versions and examples of good output
No library item picks and orders few-shot examples for a prompt
